text:
Emma: ok team — following the postmortem from Friday's multi-region latency spike, can we assign owners for the action items? I'll draft a RACI and timelines here.
Raj: i can take infra-related ones (autoscaler + instance types). will create JIRA.
Claire: i'll own the testing/e2e checklist and add a regression test. target: 2 weeks?
Dan: i'll do the runbook improvements and oncall playbooks. can we set due by 2026-04-20?
Emma: thanks — quick RACI draft: Responsible: Raj (infra), Claire (tests), Dan (runbook); Accountable: Emma; Consulted: Julia (sre), Mike (eng-tools); Informed: all. Thoughts?
Julia: sounds good. i'll review runbook once Dan posts PR.
Dan: creating JIRA now. ticket INF-4826 for autoscaler tuning? or should infra create that?
Raj: i'll make infra tickets: INF-4826 (autoscaler/autoscale-policy), INF-4827 (instance-type-testing). linking tests and runbook as sub-tasks.
Emma: please link postmortem doc and add labels: postmortem, p1-followup, owner-assigned. Use epic PM-2026-04 if possible.
ops-bot: Reminder: Add severity and customer impact fields to JIRA. Runbook PRs should reference incident-id: INC-2026-0416.
Claire: timeline: tests in 10 business days. will open TST-3129 and add test plan. tagging @Mike for CI help.
Mike: happy to help — will schedule CI capacity and quick preflight. expect a small config change.
Dan: done — created RUN-3142 for runbook updates and referenced INC-2026-0416. PR link: https://git.company/runbooks/pull/48
Raj: tickets created: https://jira.company/browse/INF-4826, https://jira.company/browse/INF-4827. assigning INF-4826 -> Raj, INF-4827 -> Raj.
Emma: great. owners: Raj, Claire, Dan. i'll mark accountable on the PM ticket and set weekly check-in every Thursday until closed. who wants to own weekly update?
Julia: i can own weekly update for SRE side.
Emma: assign Emma for PM updates + Julia for SRE. need handoff if someone is OOO: Raj -> Mike backup, Claire -> Julia backup.
Mike: :thumbsup: noted
Claire: adding acceptance criteria now: tests must cover warm-cache, cold-start, and regen path. snippet:
```
- warm cache: ensure <95th pctl latency under load
- cold start: validate under scale-up events
- regen path: verify fallback correctness when cache misses
```
Emma: closing loop: task list in the postmortem doc updated, jira links posted. next check-in Thu 10:00 PT. thanks.
